title: BulkCreateResult
description: Per-input outcomes of a bulk create requested with an explicit onConflict policy. Validation failures and conflicts are isolated to the affected inputs. Authentication, malformed requests and unexpected server failures remain HTTP errors.

conflictPolicy.description: How to report existing FQNs and repeated FQNs in the request. Both policies continue creating other valid inputs; neither updates existing entities. The first valid occurrence of a new FQN wins.

item.description: Outcome for one input, identified by its zero-based request index even when names are repeated.

id.description: ID of the newly created entity. Absent for skipped and failed inputs.

reason.description: Stable reason code for a skipped or failed input. Absent for created inputs.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of a skipped or failed input.

results.description: Exactly one outcome per input, in request order. Counts sum to the number of inputs.
